definitions.volume: USD swap activity; DefiLlama daily series.
definitions.fees: Gross protocol and affiliate swap fees; DefiLlama dailyFees.
definitions.revenue: Revenue-wallet collections excluding internal hops; may lag fees.
definitions.buy: Successful incoming native NEAR to buybacks.multisignature.near; all senders including treasury/refunds; receipt arrival assumed purchase time; unique receipt_id and transfer_index.
definitions.buyUsdEstimate: Incoming NEAR weighted by arrival-day market price; NOT actual purchase expenditure.
definitions.mint: Gross issuance from exact epoch-boundary supply and burn records for the collected history.
definitions.burn: Issuance minus observed total-supply increase across UTC boundaries; inferred network-wide burns.
definitions.price: One near-midnight observation per UTC date, tolerance 15 minutes.
definitions.market: BTC benchmark; ETH proxy for one major altcoin, not a broad altcoin total.

supplyCoverage.method: At each epoch start, issuance = block total_supply minus previous total_supply plus balance_burnt in newly included chunks. Period burns = collected issuance minus observed change in total supply. Burns are inferred, not a transaction-fee sum.
